forum.title: How to develop software for a custom board without a 32kHz Xtal.
forum.best_answer_content:
I discovered that it works even without directly editing the code in CubeIDE; you just need to configure it correctly in CubeMX and generate the code.

I think all you need to do is avoid selecting LSE in the Clock Configuration in MX.
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I'm prototyping a custom board equipped with a WBA23KE and developing its software.

Since this custom board doesn't have a 32kHz crystal, I modified the code based on BLE\_p2pServer, referencing the description on the following website.

[LSEクリスタルなしでSTM32WBA上でRFアプリケーションを動かす方法 - stm32mcu](https://wiki.st.com/stm32mcu/wiki/Connectivity:STM32WBA_without_LSE_crystal)

However, the HAL\_RTC\_Init() function on line 615 of the attached main.c fails and goes into ErrorHandler().

How should I modify the code?
forum.author: gocchan

scraped_replies.html: In line 323 HAL_PWR_EnableBkUpAccess() is commented out. Uncomment  it.
scraped_replies.author: Pavel A.

scraped_replies.html: I commented it out, but the situation didn't change.
scraped_replies.author: gocchan

scraped_replies.html:
I discovered that it works even without directly editing the code in CubeIDE; you just need to configure it correctly in CubeMX and generate the code.

I think all you need to do is avoid selecting LSE in the Clock Configuration in MX.
scraped_replies.author: gocchan
